name: vercel-react-best-practices
summary: Agent skill with 70 prioritized rules for React and Next.js performance, from waterfalls to bundle size.
description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering, packaged as an installable SKILL.md for AI coding assistants. 70 rules are grouped into 8 categories ordered by impact — eliminating waterfalls and bundle optimization first, advanced patterns last — covering server-side rendering, memoization and re-render costs, hydration and JavaScript-level optimizations.
